messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-4121 fired — GPU memory pressure spike detected in us-west1a. scope=infer-prod-west1a; metric=gpu.mem.used_pct; value=93.6% over 30s. severity=warning
pd-bot: Paging on-call group @oncall-ops
sasha: acked. looking at node tails now (gpunode-47).
sasha: seeing repeated NVML errors in kernel logs: "NVML: GPU 0: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (alloc 1.2GB)". KV cache eviction high.
riley: on it. moving traffic to fallback model variant (quant-small) for infer-prod-west1a routes, will also reduce pool concurrency to limit allocations.
sasha: running quick drain on gpunode-47 to stop new allocations:
```
rbctl node drain gpunode-47 --reason "kvcache pressure / preemptive drain"
```
riley: kicking autoscaler +2 in west1; also applying a temporary route weight change to shift 60% to fallback: 
```
rbctl route update infer-prod-west1a --fallback-weight 0.6
```
julius: customer-impact check: support telemetry shows ~12 500s from a single tenant in the last 2m, latency spikes ~3–8s for a handful of requests. ticket created: 2026-03-17-#8891 (notified).
pd-bot: Auto-escalation timer set: will escalate to L2 in 4m if not acknowledged.
sasha: as a quick throttle, lowering pool concurrency to 1 for affected pool:
```
rbctl pool update infer-prod-west1a --max-concurrency 1 --note "mitigation: reduce concurrent KV growth"
```
riley: acknowledged PDR-4121 in PagerDuty at 1765429905. I'm staying on it. starting allocd restart on the node to clear fragmented arenas.
sasha: restarting allocator service on gpunode-47:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/allocd --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpunode-47
```
riley: eviction rate increasing; noisy keys being evicted. NVML errors frequency dropping. mem_used_pct down to 76% on gpunode-47 (30s rolling).
julius: notifying impacted customer: ETA 10m for stabilization, will update if extended.
oncall-ops: handing monitoring to morning shift (@riley) — will watch metrics and cancel escalation if stable.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-4121 acknowledged by riley at 1765429905 (note: manual ack).
riley: confirmed stabilization — percent used holding ~72–78% after drain + restart. keeping pool max_concurrency=1 for 10m then reevaluate.
sasha: creating incident stub for postmortem; tagging kvcache/allocd/fragmentation.
julius: closing customer-facing loop once we hit 15m stable window.
oncall-ops: marking thread as mitigation-complete for now. will re-open if any regression. :white_check_mark:
